documents.summary: Provost's memo to instructors: each instructor decides whether to allow or prohibit AI and must state the policy in every syllabus, with attribution of AI use expected of students. It gives four sample approaches, advice on explaining the rationale, and the route to the Center for Community Standards.

documents.summary: Provost guidance for instructors who wish to prohibit or limit AI: state a clear policy, understand why students cheat, do not use AI detectors (Turnitin AI detection cancelled Feb 2026), and follow the required reporting steps through the Center for Community Standards.
